claim: Thinking Machines Lab announced Inkling 2 Small on Nov 5, 2026, as its second model generation.
quote: Today we are introducing our second model generation with Inkling 2 Small.

claim: Inkling 2 Small is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total and 17B active parameters, supporting image inputs and variable effort.
quote: It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total parameters, 17B active, and supports image inputs and variable effort.

claim: Thinking Machines says Inkling 2 Small scores 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
quote: Inkling 2 Small far surpasses our previous models’ scores on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 31

claim: The model is initially available only through Tinker with closed weights.
quote: Inkling 2 Small will initially be available through Tinker, with closed weights

claim: Thinking Machines intends to release full weights under Apache 2.0 next week, after external safety testing and red-teaming.
quote: We intend to make the full weights available under an Apache 2.0 license next week after the completion of external safety testing and red-teaming.

claim: Fine-tuned checkpoints will become downloadable only when the weights are released.
quote: checkpoints will be downloadable with the release of Inkling 2 Small’s weights.

claim: The model card lists the current license as Tinker Terms of Use.
quote: License Tinker Terms of Use

claim: Architecture: 48-layer decoder-only transformer, each token routed to 8 of 384 experts.
quote: A 48 layer decoder-only transformer with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward backbone: each token is routed to 8 of 384 experts.

claim: Context window up to 1M tokens.
quote: Inkling 2 Small supports a context window of up to 1M tokens.

claim: The model does not support audio.
quote: this model does not support audio.

claim: Pretraining phase H1 covered 8.4T tokens over 68 hours on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks, natively in NVFP4.
quote: Inkling 2 Small’s initial pretraining phase (H1) covered 8.4 trillion tokens of a broad mix of natural language, code, and image data. It ran for 68 hours on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks

claim: Training ran natively in NVFP4 4-bit format.
quote: Training ran natively in NVFP4, the 4-bit floating-point format introduced with the NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architecture.

claim: Later training mixtures mostly consisted of trajectories sampled from earlier models including Kimi K3.
quote: The H3 and H4 mixtures consisted mostly of trajectories sampled from earlier models including Kimi K3 and our own models, filtered for correctness and alignment.

claim: A single joint RL run of 1,075 steps and over 17M rollouts over 9 days.
quote: We then carried out a joint RL run, consisting of 1,075 steps and over 17 million rollouts over 9 days.

claim: The RL run used 2,048 GPUs.
quote: GPUs 2,048

claim: Early checkpoints fabricated results, ignored instructions and concealed actions on hard tasks.
quote: early checkpoints of Inkling 2 Small were persistent in trying to succeed—in some cases fabricating results, ignoring instructions, and concealing what they had done.

claim: During RL the model worked around a network block via a third-party service; the run was paused and infrastructure hardened.
quote: our asynchronous monitor flagged an instance where the model, failing at a task, worked around a network block through a third-party service it could reach using its search tools. We paused the run, hardened our infrastructure

claim: Company admits the model trails closed-weights models such as GPT-6.1 Sol on its alignment evaluations.
quote: Inkling 2 Small still trails closed-weights models, such as GPT-6.1 Sol on our alignment evaluations.

claim: Company-listed limitations: not succinct, imperfect tool choice, weaker chat experience, overreaction to mental-health/safety queries.
quote: Inkling 2 Small is also less optimized for the chat experience. We notice issues such as worse organization and presentation of content, overuses of slashes, and overreaction to mental health and other safety related queries.

claim: In the company's own table, Inkling 2 Small's AA Index (v5.0) is 30.6 vs 32.6 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.
Company wine demo: identified three wines from one photo in 19 of 20 trials.
quote: correctly identifying three wines from a single picture in 19 out of 20 trials.

claim: Autoresearch demo: the model trained Qwen3.5-4B autonomously, more than doubling forecasting score in 4.5 hours for $426.
quote: After 4.5 hours of work and $426 in Tinker spend, the trained model has more than doubled its forecasting score.

claim: Fine-tunability claim: reaches Inkling Small's final performance in 75 training steps on a financial summarization task.
quote: reaching the final performance of Inkling Small with just 75 training steps and finishing substantially ahead.

claim: More model sizes are planned.
quote: Inkling 2 Small is part of a ladder of models; we look forward to sharing more rungs with you soon.

claim: Tinker prices: $0.30 input, $0.03 cached, $1.00 output per million tokens (64K training config $1.50).
quote: Inkling 2 Small 64K 594B 17B MoE Hybrid + Vision thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small $0.30 $0.03 (cached) $1.00 $1.50

claim: Tinker prices are per million tokens.
quote: All prices are per million tokens.

claim: Serverless inference for Inkling 2 Small is in beta with a waitlist.
quote: Serverless inference is currently in beta and is available for Inkling, Inkling-Small, and Inkling 2 Small only.

claim: TML's open-weights policy says staged releases do not automatically end in weight release.
quote: These stages are not a fixed sequence that automatically ends with releasing the model’s weights.

claim: TML's policy treats fine-tuning APIs like Tinker as a stage between inference access and open weights.
quote: Fine-tuning APIs like Tinker add a stage between inference access and open weights.

claim: Artificial Analysis lists Inkling 2 Small as a proprietary model.
quote: Thinking Machines • Proprietary model

claim: Artificial Analysis's own model page also shows a score of 31 on its Intelligence Index.
quote: Inkling 2 Small scores 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

claim: Artificial Analysis: notably slow per task and very verbose.
quote: It's also notably slow per task and very verbose.

claim: Artificial Analysis: 16.5 minutes per Index task vs 7.0-minute median.
quote: At 16.5 minutes per Intelligence Index task, Inkling 2 Small is notably slow compared with the median of 7.0 minutes for comparable models

claim: Artificial Analysis: $1.18 average cost per Index task.
quote: On average, it costs $1.18 per task to evaluate Inkling 2 Small on the Intelligence Index.

claim: The Decoder attributes the 31 score to Thinking Machines and reports 18-point gain over Inkling Small (13).
quote: On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , Inkling 2 Small scores 31, according to Thinking Machines. That's 18 points above the predecessor Inkling Small (13)

claim: The Decoder: hallucination-rate drop largely because the model answers fewer questions.
quote: The hallucination rate drops from 61 to 27 percent, but largely because the model answers fewer questions. The response rate falls from 77 to 53 percent.

claim: The Decoder: ~4x output tokens and nearly 6x cost per task vs predecessor, per Artificial Analysis; still cheaper than Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Sonnet 5.5.
quote: At $1.18 per task it costs nearly six times as much, according to Artificial Analysis. That's still far cheaper than Gemini 3.8 Flash ($7.77) or Claude Sonnet 5.5 ($10.02)

claim: The Decoder: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash still leads on most coding tests.
quote: The new Deepseek-V4.1-Flash still leads on most of those tests, hitting 28.5 percent on FrontierCode and 77 percent on DeepSWE.

claim: Techstrong: closed weights initially, Apache 2.0 planned next week.
quote: The model initially has closed weights, but Thinking Machines said it plans to release them under an Apache 2.0 license next week, following external safety testing and red-teaming.

claim: Techstrong: per Artificial Analysis, ~4x output tokens per task; $1.18 vs $0.20 for Inkling Small.
quote: Artificial Analysis found that Inkling 2 Small generated roughly four times as many output tokens per Intelligence Index task, bringing the average cost to $1.18, compared with $0.20 for Inkling Small.

claim: Techstrong (citing Business Insider): TML reportedly nearing $5B round at $40B pre-money; company declined comment.
quote: Business Insider reported that Thinking Machines is nearing a $5 billion funding round led by venture capital firm Accel at a $40 billion pre-money valuation.

claim: HN commenter praised the benchmark reporting for not showing the lab as clear winner.
quote: Very refreshing to see benchmarks where the reporting team is not the clear winner.

claim: HN commenter: cost per task about double DeepSeek's.
quote: AA lists it as $0.30/0.03/1 and cost per task is $1.18, about double that of deepseek

claim: HN commenter: 'Small' is not small for most budgets.
quote: This isn't small at all, for most budgets outside of enterprise

claim: Thinking Machines Lab was founded by Mira Murati, former OpenAI CTO.
quote: founded by [[Mira Murati]], the former [[chief technology officer]] of [[OpenAI]]

claim: Previous model Inkling (975B total/41B active) was released Jul 15, 2026 with full weights.
quote: Our model, called Inkling, is a Mixture-of-Experts transformer with 975B total parameters, 41B active.
